scope.method: pinned-path stat and SHA-256 of the opaque archive; lsof path census

archive.current_observation: present and hash-matched by a pathname-based read

source_activity.interpretation: no process held a reported open file below this path at observation time; this does not establish inactivity, consistency, or source cutoff

limitations: The archive is an earlier best-effort live copy, not a consistent recovery point; its three log files may have changed outside read windows.
The archive does not preserve extended attributes or ACLs and has not been content-screened.
The pathname-based hash observation is not a fresh descriptor-bound Kingston readback.
The fresh branch bundle is separate and preserves Git history only; it does not replace the opaque local-state archive.
